normalized.description: The Netherlands Enterprise Agency (NEA) serves as an EU-delegated body responsible for the implementation of EU policies in the Netherlands. This mandates NEA to effectively and efficiently oversee compliance with EU regulations, particularly in relation to subsidies under the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). Therefore, NEA is looking for a Contractor to facilitate the annual obligatory Quality Assessments (QAs). These QAs pertain to the Area Monitoring System (AMS) and the Geospatial Aid Application (GSA), including rigorous sample controls integral to the Programmatic Enforcement Cycle for interventions such as the BISS, the Eco scheme, the AECM, and various conditionalities, all integral parts of the CAP. Furthermore, the Contractor will be responsible for evaluating agricultural activities on parcels that yield results from the AMS, colloquially referred to as 'red parcels'. Both the QA and the processing of 'red parcels' involve a manual inspection relying on optical imagery.
